primary_support.rule: lower 95% slide-bootstrap bound of candidate-minus-control same-residual finite sensitivity > 0

mechanistic_summary: Inverse transport reduces the observation displacement and provides positive canonicalization benefit, but the inverse-transport candidate encoder has higher general local sensitivity and an additional residual-direction-specific sensitivity component. The remaining post-transport residual is therefore disproportionately amplified in latent space, reproducing the negative RT1-style alignment direction despite successful observation-space transport.
claim_boundary: RT2 is mechanistic localization on already-observed SCORPION and cannot rescue RT1, establish external validity, or count as independent confirmation.
